column1: # Last per-minute supervisor line of every live campaign worker (aws/worker.py:
# '<rate> B it/s, <iterations this run>, <dp>, ...'), read from the workers' log copies at
# 2026-09-17 18:47 UTC.  Both counters are the client's own for the current process:
# iterations = (iterBase - timedIterBase) * walksPerLaunch on the grid the client built,
# dp = distinguished points it reported in the same interval.  No campaign constant enters.
# family is inferred from the rate (RTX PRO 6000 ~14.7, L40S ~7-8, RTX PRO 4500 ~4.8 B it/s).
# Workers with fewer than 1000 points or whose last line predates 18:00 UTC are omitted.
